<!-- Prefix the title with bug: | feat: | task: (work with no new observable result) | research: (a fact for docs/), and name the expected result, not the action. A scope like (kn-render) is optional. -->

## Problem

What is missing or wrong today, and why it matters. The problem, not the implementation.

## Proposed Behavior

What a reviewer can observe or run once this is done. Say which part is confirmed original behavior and which is a hypothesis; an unconfirmed rule is not replaced by an invented one.

## Acceptance Criteria

Binary checks, one per line: the command and what its output must show. "Works correctly" is not a criterion.

## Scope

What this ticket covers, what it deliberately leaves out, and which layers it touches.

Add `Implementation Notes` (confirmed facts with sources, open questions), `Alternatives` or `Dependencies / Related Issues` only when they carry information. Dependencies written here are prose: the relationship itself lives in the Relationships panel or in `gh issue edit --add-blocked-by`.
